create_NPUFusedMLAPreprocess: create an NPUFusedMLAPreprocess module with fused QKV projection, layer norms, rotary embeddings, and quantization config
run_mlapo_preprocess: run the MLA preprocess forward path for W8A8 quantized models using NPU MLA operations
run_mlaprolog_preprocess: run the MLA prolog preprocess path for models with unquantized kv_b_proj layers
build_transdata_block_format: build a transdata function that pads and transforms a matrix into 16x32 block format for NPU
test_is_mla_preprocess_enabled: test whether MLA preprocess is enabled via the SGLANG_NPU_USE_MLAPO environment variable
